integrity_notes: All classifications and polynomial coefficients are explicitly derived from row-column incidence constraints; two different standalone Python 3 algorithms corroborate the finite boundary and sampled larger cases.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to K_m Cartesian K_n, m,n>=2, open-neighborhood total [1,2] condition. It does not classify ordinary [1,2]-domination, general intervals, or higher Hamming products. All-order conclusions rely on a symbolic proof, not a finite test. Full publisher access to one foundational source was restricted, and historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Total \([1,2]\)-domination on rectangular rook graphs: a sharp cutoff and complete enumerator
